answer: A bond must be split across 5 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. Because each mesa escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the basalt ledger records every share and the sable audit reveals the split. Assembling that for 138 aliases means 138 times 5 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
